_readme: Default questions per role. Each question can name the intent it should route to (expectIntent), the card it should show (expectPresentation) and expectAuth: "DENY" when that role must NOT get the data. Questions added in the page are kept in the browser, not here.

roles.description: Self-service: own profile, leave, attendance, goals, policies. Team and company data must be refused.
